meaning: classifier for doors and windows; a fan (shàn)

senses.en: classifier for doors and windows; a fan (shàn)

note: 一扇门, 一扇窗; the verb "to fan" is shān.

examples.en: This room has two windows.
Please close that door.
He opened a window.

meaning: to start up (a machine); to launch (a plan)

senses.en: to start up (a machine); to launch (a plan)

note: 启动电脑/汽车 (boot, start); 启动项目 (launch a project).

examples.en: My computer starts up very slowly.
The car just won't start.

examples.zh: 公司下个月启动新项目。
examples.en: The company launches a new project next month.

meaning: charming; fascinating; captivating

senses.en: charming; fascinating; captivating

examples.en: The scenery here is very enchanting.
She looks charming when she smiles.
Shanghai at night is truly fascinating.

meaning: building; architecture; to construct

senses.en: building; architecture; to construct

note: As a noun it means a building or architecture; as a verb, to build.

examples.zh: 这个城市有很多老建筑。
examples.en: This city has many old buildings.

examples.zh: 我对中国建筑很感兴趣。
examples.en: I'm very interested in Chinese architecture.

examples.zh: 他们打算在河上建筑一座桥。
examples.en: They plan to build a bridge by the river.

meaning: loss; damage; to lose

senses.en: loss; damage; to lose

note: Loss of money or goods: 经济损失, 损失很大.

examples.zh: 这次事故造成了很大的损失。
examples.en: The accident caused heavy losses.

examples.zh: 我不想因为他的错损失钱。
examples.en: I don't want to lose money because of his mistake.

examples.zh: 下雨让农民没有损失吗？
examples.en: Didn't the rain cause the farmers any loss?

meaning: proud (of one's own or one's group's achievements)

senses.en: proud (of one's own or one's group's achievements)

examples.en: I'm proud of you.

examples.zh: 作为中国人，他觉得很自豪。
examples.en: As a Chinese person, he feels very proud.

examples.zh: 她自豪地说：“这是我做的。”
examples.en: She said proudly, "I made this."

meaning: biscuit; cookie; cracker

senses.en: biscuit; cookie; cracker

note: A single piece is 块 or 片; a packet is 包.

examples.en: I'd like to eat a few cookies.
The child finished the cookies.
Are the cookies you bought tasty?

meaning: way of saying it; wording; version or explanation

senses.en: way of saying it; wording; version or explanation

note: 有一种说法 (there is a saying that...); 换个说法 (put it another way).

examples.en: Can you put it another way?
That claim isn't right.

examples.zh: 有一种说法是喝热水对身体好。
examples.en: There is a saying that drinking hot water is good for you.

meaning: to get in touch with; to keep in contact

senses.en: to get in touch with; to keep in contact

note: 保持联络 (stay in touch); 联络方式 (contact details).

examples.en: Please contact me after you reach Beijing.
We should keep in touch.
Do you have his contact details?

meaning: to lift; to raise; to carry together

senses.en: to lift; to raise; to carry together

note: 抬头 (raise one's head), 抬手 (raise a hand), two people 抬 a heavy thing.

examples.en: He lifted his head and looked at me.

examples.zh: 这张桌子太重，我们两个人一起抬吧。
examples.en: This table is too heavy; let's carry it together.
My leg hurts and I can't lift it.

meaning: classifier for paintings, pictures, and cloth

senses.en: classifier for paintings, pictures, and cloth

note: 一幅画, 一幅照片, 一幅地图.

examples.en: A painting hangs on the wall.

examples.zh: 这幅照片是在哪儿拍的？
examples.en: Where was this photo taken?

examples.zh: 他送了我一幅中国地图。
examples.en: He gave me a map of China.

meaning: genius; natural talent

senses.en: genius; natural talent

examples.en: He is a musical genius.

examples.zh: 她不是天才，只是很努力。
examples.en: She isn't a genius, just very hardworking.
Do you think you're a genius?

meaning: to bear; to endure; to hold back

senses.en: to bear; to endure; to hold back

note: 忍不住 (can't help doing); 忍一忍 (grit your teeth).

examples.en: My tooth hurts so much I can't stand it.
Hang in there a bit, it'll be done soon.
He couldn't help laughing.

meaning: to launch (a rocket); to fire; to transmit

senses.en: to launch (a rocket); to fire; to transmit

examples.en: The new satellite launches tomorrow morning.

examples.zh: 他们成功发射了一颗卫星。
examples.en: They successfully launched a satellite.
Mobile phones send out signals.

meaning: within; inside; not exceeding

senses.en: within; inside; not exceeding

note: Time or range: 三天之内 (within three days).

examples.en: Please reply to me within three days.
Within 100 yuan, buy whatever you like.
I can get there within an hour.

meaning: to cut with scissors; to trim

senses.en: to cut with scissors; to trim

note: 剪头发 (get a haircut), 剪指甲 (cut nails).

examples.en: I want to go get a haircut.
Please cut this piece of paper for me.
He gets his hair cut once a month.

meaning: to compete; competition

senses.en: to compete; competition

note: 竞争激烈 (fierce competition); 竞争对手 (rival).

examples.zh: 现在找工作竞争很激烈。
examples.en: Competition for jobs is fierce right now.

examples.zh: 两家公司都在竞争这个客户。
examples.en: Both companies are competing for this client.
We aren't afraid of competition.

meaning: motive; motivation

senses.en: motive; motivation

note: Usually asks why someone does something: 你的动机是什么?

examples.zh: 他这样做的动机是什么？
examples.en: What is his motive for doing this?

examples.zh: 我学汉语的动机很简单。
examples.en: My motivation for studying Chinese is simple.
Without motivation, it's hard to keep going.

meaning: week (colloquial); Sunday; religious service

senses.en: week (colloquial); Sunday; religious service

note: Spoken: 下礼拜 (next week), 礼拜天 (Sunday). Written/standard: 星期, 周.

examples.zh: 下礼拜我要去上海出差。
examples.en: I'm going to Shanghai on a business trip next week.
Which day of the week are you free?
Let's go hiking on Sunday.

meaning: snake

senses.en: snake

examples.en: There's a snake in the grass, be careful.
I'm very afraid of snakes.
He was born in the Year of the Snake.
